thread:
incident-bot: [ALERT] sharp increase in external-invoke errors and token CPU (90th p50) across region-us-west-2. auto-escalation triggered. paging oncall. :rotating_light:
ryan: acked. I'm oncall for eng-sre, grabbing context. what thresholds tripped?
mira: errors spiked when structured-json outputs for agent calls hit ~8k r/s. CPU per token jumped, queue depth growing. appears correlated with customers issuing nested tool invocations.
sam: saw many retries -> cascading invokes. one tenant (acct: acme-proto) responsible for ~30% of invoke volume.
nana: tagging for customer-impact: latency SLOs degraded for gen endpoints, customers reporting timeouts. support queue has 12 tickets referencing 'agents failing' and 3 high-sev.
ops-bot: Runbook: https://playbooks/redwood/invoke-overload. Suggested immediate mitigation options: 1) global backpressure (rate limit), 2) staged plan-based blackout of external tool/function calls, 3) restrict structured JSON output generation.
ryan: we should avoid a hard global block if possible. propose staged approach: (A) throttle free-tier and dev plans immediately, (B) limit structured output streaming for high-invoke sessions, (C) isolate the top offending tenant to a quarantine quota.
mira: agree. I'll prepare the runtime flags. plan: set `invoke_rate_limit` by plan and flip `structured_output_mode` to `trimmed` for plans above threshold.
sam: how do we enact? need exact curl or control-plane steps we can run without code deploy.
mira: use control-plane API:
```
curl -X POST "https://control.redwood/api/v1/runtime/overrides" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "scope": "plan:free,plan:dev",
    "overrides": {
      "max_invoke_rps": 10,
      "allow_external_invocations": "limited",
      "structured_output_mode": "trimmed"
    },
    "reason": "emergency invoke surge - staged mitigation"
  }'
```
ops-bot: NOTE: that endpoint will propagate in ~15s to the traffic routers. use `?dry_run=true` to preview.
ryan: @mira run that for free/dev now. also create a tenant-level quarantine for acct:acme-proto: set max_invoke_rps: 2 and block streaming structured output.
mira: doing it now. posting results.
```
ops-bot: override applied: scope=plan:free,plan:dev, propagation=ok, change_id=chg-2026-INV-01 :white_check_mark:
```
ryan: confirm metrics: checking observability.
sam: Dashboards: invoke_rps dropping for free/dev as expected. error-rate for gen endpoints improving, latency p95 down from 2.1s to 1.4s.
nana: support update: we should message affected customers ASAP for any tenants moved to quota mode. I'll draft a short comms for review.
support-liaison: Draft for customers: "We detected elevated agent invocation rates causing degraded performance. We’re applying temporary limits to external tool calls and structured output for certain plans to restore stability. No model data was exposed. We're monitoring and will update in 1 hour." OK to send?
ryan: slight edits: add recovery ETA: initial stabilization estimate 30-60m, include contact for account teams.
support-liaison: updated draft posted to #customer-notices. ready to send once we confirm quarantine list.
mira: quarantine applied to acct:acme-proto as requested. tenant override change_id=chg-2026-INV-02.
ops-bot: change chg-2026-INV-02 applied successfully. propagation=ok. impacted-tenants=["acct:acme-proto"].
ryan: quick note on scope: two mitigations are in effect now: plan-level throttle (free/dev) + tenant quarantine. structured output set to trimmed for those scopes.
sam: watch for side-effects: some customers expect structured JSON for downstream parsing. we should whitelist a few enterprise tenants.
mira: enterprise plans are excluded by scope. we left prod/enterprise untouched.
nana: monitoring shows overall token CPU dropping ~42% in last 5m. good signal.
nana: support: go ahead and send comms to the list. include mitigation steps and contact.
support-liaison: outbound sent to 8 affected accounts incl. acme-proto. ack from acme team: "we can throttle on our side but appreciate the quick mitigation".
ryan: next: staged rollback plan once metrics stable: revert plan-level throttle, then lift tenant quarantine. keep `structured_output_mode=trimmed` for an additional hour to ensure no regression.
mira: set a watch rule to auto-revert if invoke_rps < baseline_threshold for 20m. if not, keep manual.
sam: assign follow-up tasks: 1) implement better per-tenant invoke budgets (engineering), 2) add a feature-flag for fast rollback without control-plane change, 3) add per-route structured-output costs to console dashboards.
ryan: assigning tasks: @ana for customer comms follow-up, @mira for audit of overrides, @sam for post-incident engineering ticket. I'll create incident record in PagerDuty and link this thread.
nana: oncall handoff: I'm going offline in 20m; @mira will take primary for next hour. mira, you good?
mira: I’m primary. ping me for rollbacks.
ops-bot: Incident note: mitigation enacted: plan-throttle + tenant-quarantine + structured-output trim. current status: stabilizing. next update in 15m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
ryan: closing loop: add timeline entries to incident doc and include the exact override payloads (chg-2026-INV-01, chg-2026-INV-02) for audit.
sam: adding retrospective items to the incident. will schedule 1-hr postmortem tomorrow.
incident-bot: Incident marked: "invoke-overload-staged-mitigation" severity: P2, owner: ryan, started_at: 2451234567.
ryan: thanks team. leaving notes here, monitoring until handoff complete.
mira: will keep thread updated. final status: stabilize -> rollback in 45m if metrics hold.
ops-bot: auto-reminder scheduled in 30m for rollback check"
